# Urowala Clinic

> Jaipur's dedicated urology centre, built around the expertise of Dr. Mohit Sharma — an AIIMS-trained Urologist providing cutting-edge laser and surgical care.

Urowala Clinic offers advanced urological care in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Led by Dr. Mohit Sharma (MCh Urology, AIIMS Bhopal), the clinic specialises in minimally invasive urology procedures including kidney stone surgery, prostate surgery, and male health treatments.

## About the Clinic

- **Name:** Urowala Clinic
- **Specialty:** Urology (Kidney, Bladder, Prostate, Male Health)
- **Lead Doctor:** Dr. Mohit Sharma, MCh Urology (AIIMS Bhopal)
- **Experience:** 8,000+ successful procedures
- **Phone:** +91 91835 70761
- **Locations:** Mansarovar, Jaipur & Sanganer, Jaipur

## Services Offered

- Kidney Stone Surgery (URS Laser, PCNL, ESWL)
- Prostate Surgery (TURP, HoLEP)
- Bladder Cancer Treatment
- Male Infertility & Andrology
- Laparoscopic Urology
- Urinary Tract Infections
- Erectile Dysfunction
